show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Classic Deal: HCA – Chris Gordon, Bain Capital (EP.335)
summary:
As an interlude between Season 2 and 3, this week’s show is a
classic – it’s Bain Capital and KKR’s take private of Hospital
Corporation of America (HCA) in 2006. The $33 billion club
deal was the largest private equity transaction in history at the
time and was significantly larger than any deal since KKR’s famous
run at RJR Nabisco in the late 1980s.

key_points.text: As an interlude between Season 2 and 3.
The $33 billion club deal was the largest private equity transaction in history at the time and was significantly larger than any deal since KKR's famous run at RJR Nabisco in the late 1980s..
The HCA deal showed the private equity industry the scale of what was possible and set the stage for both mega buyouts and public to private deals ever since..
